source.title: HeYangTek HY SPI NAND family: HY SPI 1G datasheet v2.3, 2022-04-26 (ID C9 21; the register map, the Read ID framing and the ECC status this family shares); the 2 Gbit part HYF2GQ4UAACAE (ID C9 52) by FiiO's V2.57 kernel chip table (yhy_midc9: 2048 main, 131072 block, 128 spare, 268435456 capacity) and the U-Boot heyang driver (ID method opcode+address, 0x52, 2048+128, 64 pages, 2048 blocks)

review.note: The 2 Gbit A-series datasheet (HYF2GQ4UAACAE/HYF2GQ4UADCAE, HY SPI 2G) was not at hand; the T-series HY SPI 2G v1.3.8 (HYF2GQ4UT*CAE, ID 01 25, 6-bit ECC) is another die. Review it when obtained: the ID, geometry, marker and ECC status must agree with this profile.
review.kernel: firmware/kernels/v2.57.json, chips.hyf2gq4u: the stock driver admits ECCS 00b and 01b and refuses 10b and 11b (deal_ecc_status at 0x804f12f0).
